new_articles.title: Hyundai Motor India partners Jio-bp to integrate EV charging networks
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai Motor India partners Jio-bp to integrate EV charging networks'이다. Through this collaboration, EV customers will be able to discover, access and use Jio-bp pulse charging stations using the myHyundai app, Hyundai Motor India Ltd's integrated EV charging platform. ece Hyundai Motor India Ltd on Tuesday said it has entered into a partnership with Jio-bp to integrate their respective EV charging networks and enhance charging accessibility for EV users across India Through this collaboration, EV customers will be able to discover, access and use Jio-bp pulse charging stations using the myHyundai app, Hyundai Motor India Ltd's (HMIL) integrated EV charging platform, further enhancing charging convenience and accessibility, the company said in a statement " He further said, "Through the integration of our charging networks, we are simplifying the charging journey and enabling Hyundai EV owners to access a wider network of reliable charging solutions through the myHyundai app Our partnership with Hyundai Motor India reflects that shared conviction Together with Hyundai, we are making it easier for customers to access this network directly through the app," he noted. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: Hyundai taps Reliance-backed Jio-bp to take EV charging network to 37,000+ points
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai taps Reliance-backed Jio-bp to take EV charging network to 37,000+ points'이다. Hyundai Motor India and Jio-bp are integrating their electric vehicle charging networks. This partnership expands charging points to over 37,000 across India. Users can now access Jio-bp's 7,000 charging points through the myHyundai app. Hyundai plans to significantly increase its own fast-charging stations by 2030. This collaboration aims to enhance charging accessibility and reduce customer anxiety. Hyundai plans to significantly increase its own fast-charging stations by 2030 As we continue to expand our EV product line-up in India, we are witnessing a shift in customer concerns from range anxiety to charging anxiety, underscoring the growing importance of accessible, reliable, and convenient charging infrastructure,” said Hyun Sup Lee, executive director and function head, corporate planning, Hyundai Motor India Our partnership with Hyundai Motor India reflects that shared conviction By bringing our nationwide network and high-performance charging infrastructure to Hyundai, we are not just adding charging points, we are building that trust together,” said Sarthak Behuria, chairman, Jio-bp Hyundai plans 600 fast-charging stations by 2030 Hyundai Motor India currently operates 183 DC fast-charging stations and plans to increase the network to 600 stations by 2030.

new_articles.title: South Korea’s Hyundai, union agree on tentative wage deal after rare full-day strike
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'South Korea’s Hyundai, union agree on tentative wage deal after rare full-day strike'이다. South Korean carmaker Hyundai Motor and the union representing its workers have reached a tentative deal on wages and bonuses, both sides said on Tuesday after a rare full-day strike. Around 40,000 employees of a roughly 73,000-strong domestic workforce at the country’s largest carmaker walked off the job on Friday, according to union figures, in the first such action for a decade. The union said on Monday that it had returned to talks with the company and had postponed shorter strikes planned. . new_articles.title: Samsung, SK Hynix stand to benefit as Nvidia AI server costs surge
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Samsung, SK Hynix stand to benefit as Nvidia AI server costs surge'이다. Server manufacturers notified major data center customers, including Microsoft, Google, and Oracle, that prices for Nvidia-based AI systems would rise by more than 15% in many cases for shipments starting in early 2027. The price adjustments affected systems built on Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin and current Grace Blackwell platforms, with the exact scale of the increase varying by chip generation and memory configuration. Listen to this article in summarized format Reuters Samsung Electronics and SK hynix gained further "bargaining power" in the artificial intelligence supply chain as rising memory costs fed into prices for Nvidia-based server systems, according to a news report by Korea Herald Citing data from Counterpoint Research, the report placed SK hynix at 58% of global HBM revenue in the first quarter SK hynix established an early lead in HBM tied directly to AI accelerators, whereas Samsung maintained a larger footprint in conventional DRAM while expanding its share in advanced HBM products Counterpoint reported that the bulk of first-quarter HBM revenue stemmed from HBM3E, with HBM4 shipments expected to become more meaningful in the second half of the year As per the report, South Korean investment bank and financial services company, Hana Securities noted that the reported price increases for Nvidia-based servers put renewed attention on memory suppliers, identifying Samsung and SK hynix as prime beneficiaries amid sustained infrastructure spending projected through 2027. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
